paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for four different methods. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 8, with tick labels at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis represents BLEU scores on a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot includes four lines: Consistency-CE, shown in purple with circle markers and a dashed line, starting at approximately (0, 20) and ending at (8, 29); Inconsistency-CE, shown in dark purple with square markers and a dashed line, starting at approximately (0, 22) and ending at (8, 29); Inconsistency-CE-MP, shown in blue with diamond markers and a dashed line, starting at approximately (0, 22) and ending at (8, 29); and Consistency-Bi, shown in red with star markers and a solid line, starting at approximately (0, 25) and ending at (8, 30).
